name: McKenzie Prone Press-Up

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: Robin McKenzie Method of Mechanical Diagnosis and Therapy

steps: Lie face down on an exercise mat with your hands placed flat beneath your shoulders as if doing a push-up.
Completely relax your glutes, hips, and lower back muscles.
Using your arm strength only, press down through your palms to gently lift your chest and upper torso off the mat.
Keep your pelvis and thighs resting heavy and relaxed on the floor as your lower back sags comfortably into extension.
Hold at the top for 2 to 3 seconds while taking a relaxed breath, then slowly lower your chest back down.
coaching_cues: The lower back and glutes must remain completely limp; your arms do all the lifting.
If symptoms move away from your leg and centralize into your lower back, that is a positive clinical sign.
Stop immediately if extension increases leg pain or tingling.

sources.attribution: Cornell Health Spine & McKenzie Extension Protocol
